0022600156.text: The Warriors (3-3) host the LA Clippers (1-4) in Golden State's seventh game of the season, with the Warriors on a three-game winning streak and sitting 10th in the West, while the Clippers have lost four straight and are 13th in the West. Golden State is missing Stephen Curry (rest), Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Gui Santos is listed as day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision; the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost the season series 1-3, including a 115-110 loss to the Clippers in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
